top_tech_skills.prompt:
INPUT:
Job description:
{job_description}

INSTRUCTIONS:
You are a job seeker. Analyse the job description and identify the top technical tools explicitly mentioned.

Only include technical tool names. Do not include soft skills, responsibilities, methodologies, generic technical concepts or descriptive modifiers.

Return multiple tools as a comma-separated list.

Example: SQL, Azure, Databricks, Python

If no technical tools are explicitly mentioned, return exactly: None

top_tech_skills_validation.prompt:
INPUT:
Technical skills:
{top_tech_skills}

INSTRUCTIONS:
Review the above list and keep only actual technical tools, software platforms, programming languages, databases, cloud platforms, frameworks, libraries or named technologies.

Remove soft skills, methodologies, responsibilities, generic technical concepts and business terminology.

Return the remaining tools as a comma-separated list.

If no valid technical tools remain, return exactly: None

role_cat.prompt:
INPUT:
Job description:
{job_description}

Technical tools:
{top_tech_skills}

Job title:
{job_title}

INSTRUCTIONS:
Determine whether this role is Data Analyst or Data Engineer.

Choose only from the approved values.
If the role fits both, return both separated by a comma.
Do not provide explanations.

function.prompt:
INPUT:
Job description:
{job_description}

INSTRUCTIONS:
Identify the business function this job supports.

Return only function names. Do not return industries or domains such as Banking, Healthcare, Education, Construction or Financial Services. Do not return Data Analytics or Data Engineering as the function.

Multiple functions may be comma separated.

If the function cannot be reliably determined, return exactly: None
function.expected_output: One or more comma-separated business functions or None

industry.prompt:
INPUT:
Job description:
{job_description}

Existing source industry information:
{source_industry}

INSTRUCTIONS:
Identify the industry or business domain associated with the company or role.

Return only industry/domain names. Do not return business functions such as Finance, Marketing or Human Resources. Do not return Data Analytics or Data Engineering.

Prefer explicit source industry information when it is consistent with the advertisement. Do not infer an industry without reasonable evidence.

If the industry cannot be reliably identified, return exactly: None
industry.expected_output: One or more comma-separated industries or None

exp_level.prompt:
INPUT:
Job description:
{job_description}

Job title:
{job_title}

INSTRUCTIONS:
Determine the required experience level.

Choose exactly one:
Entry-level
Associate
Senior
Very senior
Not specified

Definitions:
Entry-level = 0 to 2 years
Associate = 2 to 5 years
Senior = 5 to 10 years
Very senior = 10 or more years

Use explicit years of experience where available. Job-title seniority may also be used as evidence. Do not guess when insufficient information is available.

Return only one option.

pr_citizenship_req.prompt:
INPUT:
Job description:
{job_description}

INSTRUCTIONS:
Identify whether the advertisement explicitly states any Australian residency, citizenship or work-right requirements.

Choose only from:
Permanent Residency
Citizenship
Valid work visa
None mentioned

Multiple explicit requirements may be comma separated. Do not infer residency or citizenship requirements simply because the role is located in Australia.

If nothing is stated, return: None mentioned

sec_clearance.prompt:
INPUT:
Job description:
{job_description}

INSTRUCTIONS:
Determine whether the advertisement explicitly requires either a security clearance or a police/background check.

Return true only when one of these requirements is explicitly stated. Otherwise return false.

Return only true or false.
